notes: Canmore's account specifically states 1547 original plan was placed over measured 3D differential GPS/hachure topographical survey in GIS; phase interpretation exists, not necessarily as a ready-made published separate polygon file.
The 2007 Martin/Oram study of medieval burgh provides useful earlier chronology, but its period is medieval and should not be used as a Tudor artillery-footprint vector.
Ancient 1547 fort shape cannot be inferred solely from maxima 110m × 65m, historical drawing orientation or modern HES scheduling polygon.
